phases.title: Admit Source-Backed BoM Evidence
entryCriteria: Architecture is reviewable enough to identify critical component candidates.
exitCriteria: Every critical BoM line has admitted supplier, manufacturer, MPN, unit cost and source reference.
BoM provenance manifest has zero critical missing-source claims.
phases.rationale: Critical BoM costs, suppliers, manufacturers and MPNs must be source-backed before cost claims are credible.

phases.title: Complete Engineering Review
entryCriteria: Calculations and assumptions have named scope, formula or model basis.
exitCriteria: All calculation and assumption review rows are accepted, revised or explicitly deferred with reviewer rationale.
phases.rationale: Deterministic arithmetic can expose claims, but engineering judgment must review envelopes, assumptions and operating cases.

topRows.issue: Marine communications and EMC review is relevant to this product class in Project engineering gate.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Acoustic modem integration, antenna/transducer mounting, cable shielding and data-loss behaviour.

topRows.issue: Depth-rated pressure boundary review is relevant to this product class in Project engineering gate.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Depth rating calculation, hull material allowables, endcap seal design and proof-pressure plan.

topRows.issue: Leak detection and abort-state review is relevant to this product class in Project engineering gate.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Leak sensor placement, abort state machine, battery isolation and recovery procedure.

topRows.issue: Survey endurance uses endurance_hours with medium confidence.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Review the formula, input values and operating envelope before treating this metric as a performance claim.

topRows.issue: Depth Rating currently evaluates as pass against 10 to 600 m for inspection-class AUV prototypes; deeper missions need dedicated pressure-vessel, seal and recovery evidence.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Supply an engineering calculation, reviewer note, test plan or datasheet-backed rationale for this envelope.

topRows.issue: Survey Endurance Target currently evaluates as pass against <=12 h plausible for compact inspection AUV concept, 12-24 h needs battery/drag budget, >24 h is high risk without a detailed energy model.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Supply an engineering calculation, reviewer note, test plan or datasheet-backed rationale for this envelope.

topRows.issue: Navigation/Control Closure currently evaluates as pass against navigation sensor bus, payload data bus, acoustic link and thrust command bus present.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Supply an engineering calculation, reviewer note, test plan or datasheet-backed rationale for this envelope.

topRows.issue: Pressure/Power/Recovery Safety currently evaluates as pass against pressure boundary, leak alarm, alarm bus, DC power, service access and recovery beacon present.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Supply an engineering calculation, reviewer note, test plan or datasheet-backed rationale for this envelope.

topRows.issue: 480 minutes mission endurance before energy-budget proof.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Confirm speed profile, payload load, reserve margin, battery derating and recovery scenario.
